guide_text: Getting a value quest such as Pagle's Fishing Rod on Turn 8 is usually pretty sick, depending on your setup.
buddy_guide_text: Your buddy is a value generating buddy, so buddy up when it costs 5-7. Be sure to reborn it with [[Prosthetic Hand||112364]], and stack effects such as [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] or [[Monstrous Macaw]] to generate helpful cards.
